name: Palenciana (Spain)
description: White field with a green diagonal stripe at the upper hoist and another at the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Palenciana (a cross of Saint James, ships and a tree).
history: Municipal flag of Palenciana; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Palenciana arms — cross of Saint James, ships and tree
